meaning: He who does not know — knowledge, and learning as the work of a lifetime
note: From “Nea onnim no sua a ohu”: he who does not know can know, once he learns. Ignorance is a starting point, not a verdict.
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
